_comment: The words of buying and selling: the cars for sale (market.*), the warehouses (carlot.*), a dealer's lot (dealer.lot.*),
the dealer and part shop maps (dealermap.*), a part shop's counter (partshop.*), the mail order (usedparts.*), the
paper's classifieds (paper.*), selling a car (sell.*) and buying one (purchase.*). Each is said one way (the first line of its pool).
Money comes in written out ({price}, {amount}, {value}, {fee}, {min}, {max}, {low}, {high}, {bankroll}: "$1,200").
{count} is a number; a .one and an .other key are the same words for one and for any other number.
Names: {car} a car's make and model, {dealer} a dealer, {shop} a part shop, {place} a dealer or a shop, {seller} who
sells, {buyer} who buys ("A kid from the high school"), {rival} a racer, {part} a part as its row describes it,
{engine} the engine's line, {from} and {last} owners before. Dates and times take a format: {time} and {until} on
the map and in the ads ({until:ddd h tt}), {since} and {until} in the sell dialog ({since:MMM d}).
Others: market.engine_modified {engine}; carlot.warehouse_of {number}; carlot.summary.* {line} what is said so far,
{room} free bays; carlot.place.* {warehouse} and {bay} numbers; dealer.lot.stock.split {front} and {back} car
counts; dealermap.far.message {travel} how far, as dealermap.far.travel.* says it in a line; dealermap.travel.other and dealermap.far.travel.other {hours};
usedparts.showing {shown}; usedparts.detail.mail {days}; sell.dealer.detail {share} in whole percent; sell.ad.fee
and sell.ad.placed {days}; sell.ad.asking {symbol} the currency's sign; sell.save_failed {message} what was said before; *.failed {error} what went wrong;
paper.enter.wont_run {problem}; paper.ad.car.headline {yy} the year's last two figures ("63"), {year} the whole of it,
{car} make and model; paper.ad.seller.private {rival}, paper.ad.seller.part {seller}; paper.ad.car.details {condition}
the condition's sentence, {mileage} written out, {history}; paper.ad.car.details.engine {details} the lines before and

{engine}; paper.ad.part.details {kind} the part's kind and {part} its condition and what comes with it; market.history.* {time} a quarter-mile time, {speed} its speed ({mph} the bare mph), {wins} and {races} and {cars}
and {owners} counts in words, {record} the record so far; market.condition.sentence {label} and {percent};
market.fuel* {left} and {tank} the fuel; purchase.confirm {year}, {condition}, {mileage}, {history}, {seller} the
seller's line. enginespecs.* is why an engine will not run, said after "It won't start: "; paper.whose.player is
the word before the player's car in a wreck headline. The player's own ad: paper.ad.seller.player {player};
paper.ad.pencil.offer {buyer}, {amount} (pencilled under it); paper.yours.title {car} the ad's headline;
paper.yours.running.* {count} days in the paper, {until} the day it runs out.
